violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary before putting on gloves to make pizza.
General employee practices. — --Food employee Pizza maker observed without proper hair restraint.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towel dispenser not operating at time of inspection.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying.
